title: Couch is great, delivery company wasnt
text:
Couch is great, delivery company wasnt. Item arrived no rips or tears. So i was happy. Though as usual the delivery guys were a struggle. Not amazons fault as its not owned by them. But there careless when it comes to peoples property like trying to go straight through a doorway with a couch when it should be obvious a couch wont fit unless angled.. and bumping into or rubbing on the customers vehicle when i said id move it if they need room and they say they have enough space.

But beyond xpo being a bad delivery company. The couch is comfortable, will eventually buy the full set.

Update, purchased sept 30 2019, over a year now no rips, tears, broken parts. Been a great couch and still super comfy.

product_metadata.title: Signature Design by Ashley Bladen Faux Leather Upholstered Loveseat, Brown
features: CONTEMPORARY LOVESEAT: Tie your living room decor together with this equally comfortable and stylish loveseat. Pillowy armrests and cushions cradle you into relaxation—all with high-style flair
PLUSH COMFORT: Enjoy high-resiliency foam cushions wrapped in supple polyester/polyurethane faux leather upholstery. Supported by a sturdy corner blocked frame and exposed feet in a faux wood finish
COFFEE BROWN FINISH: Bathed in a rich, multi-tonal brown color, this easy-to-match loveseat truly makes a bold statement in any home
PERFECT SOFA COMPANION: Measuring 69” W x 36” D x 38” H, this loveseat pairs so well with a couch or accent chair
ADDITIONAL DIMENSIONS: Seat height: 20.00" | Seat depth: 22.00" | Leg height: 3.00" | Distance between arms: 42.00" | Minimum width of doorway for delivery: 32.00"

description: If you love the cool look of leather but long for the warm feel of fabric, you’ll find the Bladen loveseat fits the bill beautifully.
